items.html: There is another benefit: for there is born the forehead of favor (Metzach deRe'uta) of Arich Anpin, where the Yesod of Atik is. Then the light of the Bina of Atik, which was not clothed at all within Arich Anpin, shines from outside upon the forehead of Arich Anpin, and illumination is added to the Yesod of Atik that is within, and its light also goes out; and then Arich Anpin gazes upon the forehead of Aba veIma and upon the forehead of Zeir Anpin, and wondrous lights without end shine in the eyes of Zeir Anpin. And then Zeir Anpin also has the power to gaze upon the forehead of Arich Anpin, and then it is called a time of favor, because the forehead of favor (Ratzon) is revealed. Understand this.
